english.title: Drive / operate / place a vehicle in an unauthorised location at Stansted Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[drove a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), elsewhere than in a place provided for the passage of such a vehicle,]_
(B)_[operated a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), elsewhere than in a place provided for the passage of such a vehicle,]_
(C)_[placed a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), elsewhere than in a place provided for the accommodation of such a vehicle,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION THE VEHICLE WAS DRIVEN / LEFT..)
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 6(1) and 2(3) of the Stansted Airport - London Byelaws, 1996 and section 63 of the Airports Act 1986.

english.notes: This Byelaw applies to any part of the Airport to which the road traffic enactments do not apply unless the permission of the Airport Company has first been obtained or unless the act is performed by a person acting with lawful authority or excuse.
